status_tracking.where: Zelle activity page in app/web ('See activity'); Payment Activity on chase.com

exceptions.customer_experience: Payment shows as pending; sender may 'Cancel This Payment' from activity while recipient remains unenrolled; a hold may be placed on funds.
exceptions.bank_handling: Chase sends first notice on Send On date and a second notice; recipient has 9 succeeding business days to enroll, else the transfer is cancelled (~10 days).
exceptions.resolution: Auto-cancel and release of funds, or completion on enrollment.

exceptions.trigger: Sent to wrong person / wrong token (recipient enrolled)
exceptions.customer_experience: Payment is final; 'Zelle payments cannot be reversed'.
exceptions.bank_handling: Customer told to call support immediately (1-800-935-9935 consumer; 1-800-242-7338 business); Chase may attempt recovery but gives no guarantee.
exceptions.resolution: Usually unrecoverable unless recipient returns funds.

exceptions.trigger: Authorized push-payment scam (customer tricked into sending)
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer calls 1-800-935-9935 option 8 to file a claim; told recovery is 'difficult'.
exceptions.bank_handling: Chase states no reimbursement for authorized Zelle payments 'except under a limited program for certain imposter scams' (Zelle network imposter-scam policy, 2023). CFPB suit over Zelle scams (Dec 2024) was dismissed with prejudice March 4, 2025.
exceptions.resolution: Case-by-case; qualifying imposter scams (e.g., bank/government impersonation) may be reimbursed.

exceptions.customer_experience: Report immediately by phone or Security Center; EFTA protections apply.
exceptions.bank_handling: Full coverage if reported within 2 business days; up to $500 liability after; 60-day statement rule; provisional credit within 10 business days; decision within 10/45/90 days.
exceptions.resolution: Reimbursement for valid, timely-reported unauthorized transactions.

exceptions.trigger: Payment identified as originating from social media contact
exceptions.customer_experience: Chase may ask payment purpose and how the sender contacted the recipient; payment may be delayed, declined or blocked; Zelle access may be restricted for untruthful answers.
exceptions.bank_handling: Policy effective March 23, 2025 under updated Zelle Service Terms; Chase cites ~50% of reported scams starting on social media.
exceptions.resolution: Payment blocked; customer directed to other payment methods with purchase protection.

exceptions.trigger: Daily tier limit exceeded or insufficient funds on Send On date
exceptions.customer_experience: App shows remaining amount within tier at setup; repeating/future-dated transfer fails without retry if funds insufficient.
exceptions.bank_handling: Chase may decline on Send On date if amount exceeds tier limit; no automatic retry.

notifications.event: recipient_not_enrolled_notice (1st on Send On date, 2nd reminder)

assessment: Deep in-app embedding (contact sync, QR, split from transaction detail, recurring) is best-in-class; Chase is the only big bank with a published social-media-origin block and purpose questionnaire, trading some false positives for scam reduction. Cancellation only for unenrolled recipients. Exact scam-interstitial wording is not public.

terms.limits: Daily tiers T0 $500 / T1 $2,000 / T2 $5,000 / T3 $10,000 (consumer); $1,000/$5,000/$7,500/$15,000 for Private Client, Business, Private Bank, Wealth Mgmt; no incoming limit
terms.cutoffs: 8 PM ET send to network banks; 11 PM ET receive same day; Chase-to-Chase within minutes
